public_rationale: The Predibase survey supports the narrower observation that experimentation exceeded production in its mid-2023 sample. It does not establish a representative rate among companies paying to test LLMs. OpenAI's later first-year revenue milestone is relevant, but it does not supply a comparable calendar-2023 revenue statement or profit figure. Annualized and monthly figures found in reporting cannot substitute for annual revenue. The complete claim therefore remains unresolved.
limitations: A partly supported adoption observation does not settle the bundled revenue and profit assertions.
The revenue basis, adoption denominator, and meaning of production are unspecified.
The survey's vendor sponsorship and sample design limit generalization.

statement.document_title: Top 5 reasons why OpenAI was probably never really worth $86 billion

from_speaker: A billion or two in revenue this year
it’s not clear how much of that is profit
a lot of companies spent money testing LLMs
few were actually using the LLMs in production
our_interpretation: This year means calendar 2023. The ordinary financial reading is approximately USD 1–2 billion of actual revenue, not an annualized run rate.
Because the post preceded year-end, the revenue amount may have been a provisional full-year estimate. It is not treated as a separately stated forecast.
The profit clause concerns what was publicly established at publication, not whether later disclosures revealed a profit or loss.
The adoption clause concerns 2023 before publication. Few means a small minority of relevant companies, without imposing an invented percentage cutoff.
The revenue assertion names no source or accounting basis. The contract therefore records unknown rather than assuming company-reported or estimated accounts.
The single target period covers the explicitly named year; post-publication adoption changes cannot settle the pre-publication adoption clause.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable calendar-2023 revenue is approximately USD 1–2 billion, contemporary public reporting leaves profit undetermined, and representative evidence shows experimentation substantially exceeding production among relevant companies.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable calendar-2023 revenue falls outside the approximate range, contemporary public records clearly establish the profit amount, or representative pre-publication evidence shows production was widespread among companies testing LLMs.

evidence.excerpt:
The survey was conducted from May to July of 2023
with respondents representing 29 countries.
evidence.locator: Page 2, Introduction; page 5, Enterprise adoption of LLMs
evidence.explanation: The survey of 150 people reports 44% experimenting only, 13% with one or two LLMs in production, and 1% with more than two. This supports experimentation exceeding production in this sample, but does not establish spending, a representative company-wide rate, or November conditions.

evidence.excerpt: Within a year of launching ChatGPT, we reached $1B in revenue.
evidence.explanation: This retrospective disclosure is consistent with a billion-dollar revenue milestone around the relevant year. Its period and measurement are insufficiently specified to establish realized calendar-2023 revenue or profit.

evidence.excerpt: Since ChatGPT’s launch just nine months ago, we’ve seen teams adopt it in over 80% of Fortune 500 companies.
evidence.locator: We’ve seen unprecedented demand for ChatGPT inside organizations; footnote A
evidence.explanation: This is material evidence of broad organizational contact with ChatGPT. The footnote defines the measure as registered accounts associated with corporate email domains, so it does not establish production deployment or contradict the survey's narrower measure.

evidence.excerpt: Another 44% said their organization has so far only used LLM for experimentation purposes.
evidence.locator: Opening discussion of the Predibase survey
evidence.explanation: This dated contemporaneous report establishes that the survey was public before Marcus's post. It is not an independent second adoption sample.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable calendar-2023 revenue accounts, a dated record of contemporary profit disclosure, and representative pre-November-22 survey data distinguishing paid trials from production deployment.
